# SHE SENDS THE JAGUARS HOME!

Three hundred years of loyal service — ENDED by a signature! The emerald guard that protected every leader of this nation since the Viceroy has been DISBANDED to save the price of a few breastplates. THE WATCHMAN asks: who guards the President now? And more importantly — who guards the Republic from a President who throws away its oldest shield?
